The '''Jermac system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Jermac]], a notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]] producer.<ref name="TEA" />
